title: New monster in the Midway: Why Jeffery Simmons could be worth the price for Bears in a wide-open NFL

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: New monster in the Midway: Why Jeffery Simmons could be worth the price for Bears in a wide-open NFL
sources.description: Simmons is a one-man game-wrecker on every down and in every situation, which will give a needed lift to a Chicago defense that has been punching above its weight this season despite some flaws.
